_**Agent (copilot/gpt-5.3-codex)**_

For AppTemplate now, you can do either, but the default is Ollama.

Current behavior in your code:
1. AppTemplate server supports both providers via env config.
2. LLM_PROVIDER controls it: openai or ollama.
3. If unset, it defaults to ollama.

Important architecture point:
1. The widget itself does not package or run Ollama.
2. The widget is just frontend + iframe loader.
3. Model execution happens on your backend server.
4. That backend can call OpenAI or an Ollama/Open WebUI endpoint.

So:
1. Use OpenAI when you want easiest hosted quality and no model-hosting infra.
2. Use Ollama when you control the backend host and want local/private model serving.
3. End users embedding the script never need Ollama installed in their browser/site.
